insights: FlightRecorder is a conceptual abstraction - TheObserver is the implementation
TheObserver must remain passive (no Empirica) for scientific integrity
FlightRecorder events contain rich epistemic information
Empirica can analyze FlightRecorder events without modifying TheObserver
A wrapper/adapter pattern could bridge FlightRecorder and Empirica
patterns: Conceptual abstractions can have different implementations
Analysis can be separate from recording
Epistemic insights can be derived from event streams
Adapter pattern enables integration without modification
questions: How to extract epistemic insights from FlightRecorder events?
What patterns in events indicate learning or knowledge gaps?
How to track evolutionary trajectories epistemically?
Should FlightRecorder analysis be real-time or batch?
What metrics from events map to epistemic vectors?

actionable_suggestions.title: Design FlightRecorder-Empirica Integration
actionable_suggestions.description: Create adapter/wrapper that analyzes FlightRecorder events and logs insights to Empirica
